title: Ten Minutes Past Ten (overlapping stakeout durations)
source: Hand-authored, explicit interval durations designed to exercise overlaps/overlapped-by/during/contains, expanded to 5 threads / 45 events / 6 cross-thread links

threads.label: Denny, street lookout in the café

events.text: Priya parks the van at 9:58 and keeps the engine running until 10:22.
At exactly 10:00, the crew slips through the service door and doesn't emerge again until 10:15.
Sana takes her position on the roof at 9:55, before Priya even arrives, and climbs down at 10:10.
The vault door swings open at 10:05, just as the crew finishes cutting the last wire.
She edges the van forward from 10:12 to 10:25, the last stretch of the wait.
Sana radios the all-clear at 10:15, the exact second the crew re-emerges.
The crew splits the cash at 10:16, moments after climbing back out.
Priya finally pulls away at 10:25, the instant her last stretch of idling ends.
Sana leaves the roof entirely by 10:20, five minutes after the all-clear.
She double-checks the side mirror in the first few minutes, from 9:58 to 10:05.
From 10:03 she keeps her foot hovering over the clutch, all the way until the engine cuts out at 10:22.
She cracks the window to listen at 10:10, sealing it again by 10:18.
Her hand rests on the gearshift from 10:13 to 10:20, deep in the second stretch of waiting.
The headlights flick on at 10:22 and stay lit until the instant Priya pulls away.
Priya checks her phone once she's clear of the block, from 10:26 to 10:30.
The crew jimmies the first lock at 10:00, done by 10:04.
From 10:04 the crew works the vault combination, finishing at 10:15 exactly when they slip back out.
Between 10:05 and 10:09 the crew stuffs the first bag, right as the vault door swings open.
The crew shoulders the bags at 10:15, hauling them to the door by 10:16.
By 10:17 the crew is stripping off gloves, finished by 10:20.
From 10:19 to 10:23 the crew wipes down the counters.
She settles low against the parapet from 9:55 to 9:59, the very start of her watch.
From 9:59 she keeps her scope trained on the street, until she climbs down at 10:10.
Between 10:02 and 10:06 Sana counts patrol cars passing below.
From 10:10 to 10:15 Sana waits crouched by the stairwell door, scope lowered.
At 10:15 she keys her radio open and holds the channel until 10:18.
From 10:18 she gathers her gear, gone by 10:20.
Farah is forced flat on the marble floor at 9:59 and isn't allowed up until 10:16.
For the first few minutes, 9:59 to 10:03, Farah stares at the barrel of a gun inches from her face.
From 10:03 she counts her own heartbeat to stay calm, all the way until she's finally let up at 10:16.
Between 10:05 and 10:09, Farah hears the vault door groan open just feet from where she lies.
From 10:09 she listens to bags being filled, right up until she's allowed to stand at 10:16.
At 10:16 Farah is helped to a chair, and sits there trembling until 10:19.
From 10:18 to 10:23 Farah gives her first shaky account to the responding officer.
Between 10:20 and 10:22 Farah remembers the exact words one robber used.
At 10:23 Farah finally asks someone to call her husband.
Denny watches the van from a café window starting at 10:08, never looking away until it finally pulls off at 10:26.
From 10:08 to 10:12 Denny clocks two patrol cars idling at the corner.
From 10:12 he tracks the van's every inch of movement, all the way to 10:26.
Between 10:14 and 10:18 Denny texts a single coded word to no one in particular, just habit.
From 10:18 Denny keeps one eye on the bank's side door, until the van finally rolls at 10:26.
At 10:26, the exact second the van pulls away, Denny exhales.
From 10:26 to 10:30 Denny lingers over a cold coffee, watching the street settle.
Between 10:27 and 10:29 Denny counts the pedestrians who never noticed a thing.
At 10:30 Denny finally gets up and walks the other way.
